title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
A cryptocurrency scam used an AI-generated fake website to deceive a victim about his account balance and investment holdings. The fake website overlaid a legitimate trading app, showing false balances that grew with each small transaction, building the victim's confidence to invest larger sums. This is a model failure deployed in a real-world deception: the AI system generated a visual interface designed to impersonate a legitimate financial platform.

The fraud was not caught until the victim attempted a large withdrawal and discovered he could not access the funds. A human review of the account or transaction history before allowing large transfers, or a verification step requiring the victim to confirm his balance through a separate legitimate channel, might have detected the discrepancy. It is not established whether the legitimate trading app itself had security measures that could have identified the overlay or blocked access to the fake website.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple has lost nearly $800,000 in a sophisticated cryptocurrency scam that began when a stranger contacted Jerry Dunaway through WhatsApp. The scammer convinced Jerry to invest in cryptocurrency using a mobile trading app, building trust by allowing him to make small trades and withdraw funds initially. Unknown to Jerry, the scammers had created an artificial intelligence-generated fake website that showed false investment balances on his screen, manipulating what he believed he owned.

The couple discovered the fraud last week when Jerry attempted a larger withdrawal and found he could not access the funds. Gwinnett County police confirmed that while the trading app itself was legitimate, scammers had overlaid a fake version to deceive him. Jerry and his wife Mindy are now speaking publicly to warn others about the sophisticated tactics used by criminals. Police indicate that victims in these cases rarely recover their money. The couple's children have started a GoFundMe campaign to help with their living expenses as they work with law enforcement.
